On "ships today", nothing ships same day. In-stock units leave the warehouse within about 2 to 5 business days. Live right now: Hammer BC04 6 TH/s at $249, Thor P2 10 TH/s at $379, Bitfortun BS-4 18 TH/s at $599.99.

Want me to price one of those against what you've got coming?
